text: Eilidh flies to Auckland on the 14th of November, overnight via Singapore. She's dreading the long haul with the twins.
Jess got the promotion! Team lead from 1 December. Must send her something nice before the weekend.

Wiremu and his fiancée Mere have finally set the date: 22 August next year, at her family's marae near Rotorua. He wants a small do, maybe sixty people, but her side alone is nearly a hundred. Save-the-dates go out in January. He asked whether I'd be up for flying over a week early to help, which I'd love to do if work allows. Check annual leave before replying to him.
Marisol's last day at the bank is Friday at 4pm. Leaving drinks after at the Crown. I'm going straight from work.
Gustavo mentioned his parents' ruby anniversary is on the 3rd of June. They're doing a meal at home rather than a party.
Remind me to text Zofia on Monday morning to see how her first day at the council went.
Hannah is nervous about her interview with the airline on 09/11 at half 10. Second round, panel of three. I should send her a good luck message the night before.
Agnieszka's brother Tomasz is getting married in Kraków on 18 July. She's asked if I can help with a speech in English.
Julia has been offered the Lisbon secondment. Six months, starting in January. Her partner isn't thrilled.
Saanvi said Andile is retiring at the end of March after thirty-one years at the hospital. There's a collection going round; need to chip in by the 20th.
Teresa and Paolo celebrated ten years married on Saturday. They went back to the hotel in Sorrento where they had their honeymoon.
Don't forget: Saskia's engagement party is on 7 December at 7pm. Bring a card and a bottle.
Nasser starts at the new firm tomorrow morning. Commercial property, which he says is a step up. Ask him on Thursday how the first week is going.

Chiara's wedding in Puglia is off. She and Marco split up in September, and she's only now telling people. She's lost the deposit on the villa and is trying to get the flights refunded, which is a nightmare. Her sister Francesca has moved in with her for a few weeks. Gently check in with her this week, and don't mention the hen weekend.
Noah's flight home from Toronto lands at 6:40am on the 2nd. His mum is collecting him.
Mai told me she's been passed over for the manager role again. Quite flat about it. She's thinking of looking elsewhere in the new year.
Lucy and Jin are off to Japan for three weeks from the 10th of October. Jin has planned every single day in a spreadsheet.
Need to book the airport parking for 26/10, and renew my passport before then.
Nadia's dad retires next Friday. She's organising a surprise lunch for him at noon and wondered if I knew any good Italian places.
Yaw got engaged to Elena over the weekend! Proposed on a beach in Ghana while they were visiting his grandmother. Send congratulations to both of them.
Isabel is starting as deputy head on 6 January. Until then she's still in her old classroom job. She seemed excited but a bit overwhelmed.
Catalina mentioned their anniversary is on the 12th, and she'd love a proper weekend away. Lars has no idea, apparently. Might drop him a hint.
Aneesh flies out to Chennai on Sunday at 11pm for his cousin's wedding. Back on the 30th.
Vera asked me to water her plants while she's in Crete, 4th to 11th of May.

Coffee with Bridget this morning. Her husband has been made redundant after nineteen years at the plant. Last day is 31 October, and they've cancelled the anniversary cruise they'd booked for November. She's putting a brave face on it but she's clearly worried about the mortgage and their youngest starting uni next year. He has a couple of interviews lined up, one on the 4th at 2pm.
Kai is off on his gap year trip at the start of next month. Vietnam, Laos, then Australia to work. His mum's a nervous wreck.
Lunch with Paolo today. He's been at the restaurant group for five years now, runs two sites. Mad about cycling, wants to do the Étape next summer.
Eilidh's sister Fiona has her hen do in Dublin on the 15th of February. Eilidh is maid of honour and slightly panicking about the budget.
Must ring Wiremu tomorrow afternoon about the flights for the reunion trip. Prices jump after the 1st.
Jess and her husband Rob have their fifth anniversary on 19 November. Wood is the traditional gift. She said she'd love a carved chopping board.
Marisol started at the charity on Monday. Ask how she's finding it. She said the commute is brutal, an hour and a half each way.
Holiday sorted: Madeira, 3rd to 10th of March. Flights at 6am from Gatwick, which is grim, but cheap.
Gustavo is moving to Berlin for the new job in January. Rental market there sounds horrendous. He's going over on 28 November to view flats, Thursday at 2pm and Friday morning.
Zofia's dog Biscuit had his operation yesterday. She's off work until Wednesday looking after him.

Hannah got the airline job! Cabin crew training starts on 4 January in Crawley and lasts six weeks, with exams at the end. She's over the moon but already worrying about the swimming test, since she's never been a strong swimmer. Her boyfriend Dan is going to drive her down on the Sunday. Her first proper flights should be some time in late February.
Agnieszka mentioned that her husband's grandad turns ninety on the 21st, and the whole family's flying to Gdańsk for it.
Saanvi is struggling with jet lag after the Sydney trip. Back at work today and barely functioning, she said. Text her later to see if she survived.
Phone call with Andile. He's planning to spend his first month of retirement walking the Camino. Leaves on 2 April, and his wife Thandi will join him for the last week in Santiago.

Teresa's daughter Ana graduates on 14 July, ceremony at 11am in the cathedral, then lunch. Teresa wants the whole family there, including her ex-husband, and is fretting about seating. Ana only gets four tickets. Paolo has offered to stay outside with the little ones. Teresa also mentioned she's applying for the head of department job at her school; the deadline is the 30th.

Saskia said Nasser proposed in Paris last month, at the restaurant where they had their first date. Wedding probably next autumn, possibly in Morocco so his grandmother can come. Saskia wants to keep the engagement party small. She's a keen potter and mentioned she'd love a proper wheel for the new flat. Thinking of a joint gift with Chiara.

Chiara's new job at the design agency is going well, apparently. She's leading the rebrand pitch on Tuesday at 9am and feels quite nervous about it. I should send her a quick good luck text Monday night.
Need to buy a card for Noah and his partner's engagement. Party is Saturday the 9th, 8pm onwards.

Mai's parents are celebrating their golden anniversary in Hanoi in late December. Mai and her brother Duc are flying out on the 18th and staying until New Year. She mentioned her mum keeps asking when Mai will settle down, which she finds exhausting.

Lucy said the Japan trip was incredible, but Jin lost his wallet in Kyoto on day two and spent a morning at the police box. Someone handed it in with everything still inside, which apparently happens all the time there. They both want to go back in spring for the cherry blossom. Lucy's already looking at flights for early April. Ask Lucy for the name of that ryokan.
Dentist moved to Tuesday 4 November at 8:30am. Also need to pick up euros before Thursday.
Jin's boss is leaving at Christmas and he's been asked to apply for her job. Interview probably mid-January. He doesn't feel ready.

Nadia and her fiancé Omar have postponed their wedding from June to 12 September because the venue double-booked them. She's livid. Half the guests had already booked flights from Beirut, and Omar's grandparents can't travel in autumn. They're looking at a smaller blessing in Lebanon in June instead, then the big party in September. Must ask her for the new invitation details once they're printed.
Bumped into Yaw at the station. He's just back from a work trip to Lagos and already flying to Accra on the 5th for his sister's wedding. Looked shattered.
Elena's first day as a paramedic was on 1 October. She texted to say it was terrifying but brilliant. Follow up to see how the night shifts are going.
Isabel and Kai have booked their honeymoon: two weeks in Sri Lanka from the 2nd of August. She keeps sending me photos of the treehouse hotel.
Remind me to ask Catalina how Lars got on at his promotion review. It was this morning at 10.
Aneesh's wife Priya is pregnant, due in April. They're cancelling the New Zealand trip they'd planned for February.
Vera is retiring on 30 June. Forty years teaching piano. She says she'll finally learn to sail. Don't forget to organise something for her with the others; she's always loved Bridget's garden.
Bridget said her son Callum got his first job, an apprenticeship with an electrician. Starts on the 17th at 7:30am sharp.
Lars is flying to Stockholm on Thursday at 6pm for his father's funeral. Back on Tuesday. Ring him over the weekend.
Weekend plans: packing on Saturday, airport Sunday at 5am, Tenerife for a week. Out of office set until the 27th.
Paolo's wife Giulia is surprising him with a trip to Venice for their twentieth anniversary on 8 May. He mustn't find out. She's asked me to keep the 7th to the 11th free at work for him.

Long chat with Eilidh about her new role in Edinburgh. She officially starts on 13 January, but there's an induction on 8/01 at 9am. Her partner Struan is staying in Glasgow until the flat sale goes through, probably March. She'd like a plant for the new office.
Jess's mum Mrs Thomas is having her hip done on 2 December. Jess is flying back from Spain the day before to be with her. I need to check in with Jess the following week.
Marisol's colleague Gonzo, Gustavo Reyes really, is leaving for a job in Madrid. His farewell drinks are on Thursday the 23rd at 6pm. Saw it on the group chat.
